findings.expected_vs_actual: A-4 says that bounding 10 * minimumStack(stakes) by MAX_SAFE_INTEGER makes every chip amount a hand can produce a safe integer, because a seat can put in at most minimumStack under the 4-bet cap. Actual: legalActions has no raise cap (a raise is always offered while the stack covers it; preflop betCount passed 25 in a 10-seat hand), and SPEC-04 accepts stacks up to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. A hand that createHand accepts (stakes at the A-4 bound {1,1,1,floor(MAX_SAFE/80)-1}, 10 seats of MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) and plays legally to showdown produces 11 unsafe numbers (largest 90071992547408820). All SPEC-05 behaviours as written pass; the stated safety guarantee does not hold. The missing raise cap is in code this task did not change; the minimumStack doc comment also claims a 4-bet cap.
findings.fix: Follow-up rather than a blocker: either enforce the 4-bet cap in legalActions/applyAction (TASK-1.4 behaviour), or also bound stacks (or 10 * max stack) in createHand so pot totals stay safe integers. Then remove the cap claim from the A-4 rationale and the minimumStack comment, or make the claim true.

The 10,000-hand playtest and the replay-code run are byte-identical to the base commit; so are three extra 10-seat seeds. Holdout checks: nextIntUnbiased matches a BigInt Lemire reference on about 134k cases including all edge n, and the check catches the old formula when it is put back; 20,004 random replay codes give the same decks as the base; parseCard truncates correctly at 10/11 characters and rejects 11 kinds of non-string; getter- and Proxy-based configs are read once per field and nothing is aliased after return; unsafe, NaN and Infinity stakes and stacks are rejected with the existing messages; A-4 holds exactly at its boundary; existing messages are byte-identical to base. Integrity clean. One non-blocking MEDIUM finding: the A-4 'pot totals stay safe' rationale relies on a raise cap the engine does not enforce. src/ and tests/ left clean.
